app.name: Source keys
app.summary: A row of keys with logos for a select: PC, Mac, PlayStation, Switch. A tap switches the source.
app.tile_example: PC, Mac, PS5 and Switch as keys
app.script_hint: Optional. A tap runs this script with the option as a field instead of choosing the option itself, so it can wake the monitor and switch the input.
app.field_hint: The script's field that gets the option, such as quelle or source.
app.keys_hint: Optional. One key per line as Option|logo, such as PC|windows. Logos: windows, apple, playstation, nintendo-switch, xbox, linux. Empty: every option of the select, with a logo guessed from its name.
app.labels_hint: The option's name under each logo.
